status: ACTIVE EVIDENCE-DERIVED CHANGE BASELINE — NOT HUMAN-APPROVED
business_objective: Create an informative, welcoming and visually distinctive website explaining La Bulle Bleue and APAiL, representing publicly reported activities without overpromising and helping visitors contact the association.
primary_user_intent: Understand La Bulle Bleue, its relationship with APAiL, activity examples and how to make first contact.
critical_user_journeys: Homepage → audience → activities → dated examples → email contact
Homepage → APAiL history/solidarity mission → volunteer interest → email contact
functional_requirements: Responsive one-page information site with anchor navigation
Keyboard-operable mobile navigation; Escape closes only an open menu and restores focus
Visible mailto links using publicly published apail@live.fr
No sensitive-data intake form or diagnosis request
No disputed activity venue or unverified weekly schedule
Recent activity stories dated and presented as examples, not promised sessions
Informative images have alt text, dimensions and local source paths
Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion and never hides essential content when JS/IntersectionObserver is unavailable
content_requirements: Identify La Bulle Bleue as a local APAiL initiative in Chalon-sur-Saône
Explain La Bulle Bleue began in 2021 and APAiL was created in 1995
Describe audience without diagnosis-based eligibility or clinical claims
Represent games, garden/outdoors, discovery/workshops, culture/music and outings
Date recent examples and mark mirror-derived activity information as public-post highlights, not a recurring programme
Explain APAiL's reported solidarity work without implying all projects remain active
Ask visitors to contact APAiL for current venue, dates and times
Do not publish participant names, diagnoses or medical outcomes

brand.direction: Warm, authentic, editorial, friendly and inclusive; not clinical or infantilizing
brand.provisional_system: Blue bubble motif, deep/soft blues, warm off-white, muted yellow, peach, sage and lilac
brand.logo_status: Current mark is provisional, not official master artwork

visual_requirements.hero: Image-led hero with a large local illustration and layered bubble motifs
visual_requirements.activities: Illustrated cards for games, garden, discovery/workshops and culture/outings
visual_requirements.parent_association: Distinct APAiL history and wider solidarity section
visual_requirements.asset_policy: Original local SVG illustrations only until documentary photo rights are cleared

motion.fallback: Content is visible by default; reveal enhancement runs only when observer is supported and reduced motion is off.

technical.architecture: Static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript

accessibility_target: WCAG 2.2 AA; foundation includes semantics, alt text, dimensions, keyboard navigation, reduced-motion fallback and progressive reveal. Manual screen-reader testing remains outstanding.
success_criteria: Visitors understand the relationship between La Bulle Bleue and APAiL
Visitors see activity examples without interpreting them as a fixed schedule
Local illustrations have alt text and dimensions
Reduced-motion users never receive essential hidden content
No unverified address, schedule, health claim or sensitive data
business_outcome_hypotheses: Specific activity stories may help families understand the initiative
A richer editorial visual system may feel more approachable
Outcomes require visitor feedback/measurement and are not proven by implementation
definition_of_done_loop_003: Adopt contract 0.2; deliver local SVG illustrations, activity stories and reduced-motion-aware motion; update tests/evidence; checkpoint to main and verify remote; no deployment.
